name: Arcos de la Polvorosa (Spain)
description: Seven horizontal stripes of blue, white, yellow, white, yellow, white and blue.
history: The heraldic arms and municipal flag were approved by resolution of the town council of 25 April 2001; the flag is rectangular, of proportions 2:3, formed of seven horizontal stripes in proportions 1/5, 1/10, 1/10, 1/5, 1/10, 1/10 and 1/5, from top to bottom blue, white, yellow, white, yellow, white and blue. The gold (yellow) represents the Polvorosa, the plain that gives the municipality its name.
